description: The central Home illustration: card fronts fanned and overlapping, with a CSS-only entrance and an infinite gentle sway. Cards are passed in by the caller.
name: CardFan

description: React context provider for the active language (ES/EN); resolves initial language from the server and persists toggles to cookie + localStorage.
name: CarotProvider

description: Full-width Home experience button with solid (sage block) and outline (sage keyline) variants; presses nudge down 1px.
name: ExperienceButton

description: The Home landing screen: composes the header, wordmark, fanned-cards illustration, and experience buttons. The fanned trio is server-picked and passed in.
name: Home

description: The three Home experience buttons (message / question / daily) and their navigation.
name: HomeActions

description: Home top row: language toggle on the left and the welcome eyebrow centred.
name: HomeHeader

description: ES / EN minimal segmented language switch; the active language is highlighted in sage.
name: LangToggle

description: Home landing route. Server-picks a random trio of cards (force-dynamic) and renders the Home screen.
name: Page

description: Root layout: resolves the request language from the x-carot-lang header, loads fonts, and wraps the app in CarotProvider.
name: RootLayout

untestabilityReason.justification: reads request headers and renders the html/body shell

description: The EL CAROT wordmark — a single static display-serif heading. No props, no branching.
name: Wordmark

untestabilityReason.justification: single static h1 wordmark, no props or branching

description: Deterministic card-of-the-day index: hashes the local Y/M/D into a deck position so the whole calendar day shows the same card.
name: dailyCardIndex

description: Formats the drawn date for the daily badge in the active language (ES long form / EN month-day form).
name: formatDailyDate

description: Picks N distinct random cards (Fisher–Yates over deck indices, clamped to [0, deck.length]) for the Home fan illustration. RNG is injectable for deterministic tests.
name: pickFan
